name: Strava-to-Dawarich
description: Import your Strava activities into Dawarich, on its own.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The Strava sign-in (tokens.json, which can read your activities, so keep it private) and the list of activities already imported (state.json).

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Setup page (connect Strava, see what was imported), published on host as 6176

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: STRAVA_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Required. The Client ID (a number) of your own Strava API app, from https://www.strava.com/settings/api.

variables.name: STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Required. The Client Secret of your Strava API app, from the same page.

variables.name: DAWARICH_URL
variables.description: Required. Your Dawarich address, without a slash at the end. For Dawarich from IceStore on this MOS, type http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6175 with YOUR-SERVER-IP replaced by your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6175.

variables.name: DAWARICH_API_KEY
variables.description: Required. The API key from Dawarich, under Account settings.
